description.zh: 触控目标是手指能点中的可交互范围，不等于图标看起来多大。苹果 HIG 建议至少 44×44 CSS 像素，Material 建议 48dp；相邻目标之间还要留约 8px 间距，避免误触。视觉小图标可以用透明内边距或伪元素把热区撑大，而不用改变外观。
description.en: A touch target is the tappable area a finger must hit, not the icon size. Aim for 44×44 CSS px (48dp), about 8px between targets, and pad small icons to size.

use_when.zh: 任何需要手指或鼠标点击、拖动的可交互控件
use_when.en: Any control a finger or pointer taps, drags or presses

use_when.zh: 图标按钮、关闭按钮、列表行等视觉尺寸偏小的元素
use_when.en: Icon buttons, close buttons and list rows that look small

use_when.zh: 边缘或角落里的操作，容易和相邻目标一起点到
use_when.en: Edge and corner actions that sit close to their neighbours

avoid_when.zh: 纯展示、不可点击的图标与装饰元素
avoid_when.en: Decorative icons that are never interactive

avoid_when.zh: 桌面端密集数据表格内的单元格选择
avoid_when.en: Dense desktop data grids where cells are selected intentionally

avoid_when.zh: 把热区无节制扩大导致相邻目标重叠
avoid_when.en: Blowing up hit areas until neighbouring targets overlap

note.zh: 苹果建议的最小可点尺寸
Material 建议的最小触控目标
WCAG 的合规底线，产品应做得更大
note.en: The accessibility floor — ship larger in practice

note.zh: 热区 44×44 起，主操作最稳妥
note.en: Hit area from 44×44 — safest for primary actions

note.zh: 视觉 24px，靠透明 padding 撑到 44px
note.en: 24px glyph grown to 44px with transparent padding

note.zh: 用行高与内边距扩热区，不改视觉
note.en: Extend the hit area with line-height and padding

notes.zh: 给可交互元素设 min-width / min-height: 44px（或 48px），并在容器上用 gap 保证目标间距，而不是靠 margin 互相挤。图标视觉保持 24px，用 padding: 10px 把热区补到 44px；不方便加 padding 时用 ::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -10px; } 扩展热区。onmouseover 出现的内容不算触控目标。触摸端加 touch-action: manipulation 去掉 300ms 双击缩放延迟。
notes.en: Give interactive elements min-width / min-height: 44px (or 48px) and use gap on the container for spacing instead of margins. Keep the glyph at 24px and pad it to 44px; when padding is awkward, expand with ::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -10px; }. Content only revealed on hover is not a valid target. On touch devices add touch-action: manipulation to drop the 300ms double-tap delay.

basic.zh: 统一可交互控件的触控目标尺寸，让手指在手机上都能轻松点中。
basic.en: Unify touch target sizes across controls so every action is easy to tap on a phone.

design.zh: 触控目标规范：可点区域至少 44×44 CSS 像素（Material 48dp）；相邻目标之间留 8px 以上间距；视觉小于 44px 的图标用透明内边距或伪元素补足热区；默认图标 24px 配 10px 内边距达到 44px；列表行高不低于 44px；任何操作都不应只能 hover 触发。
design.en: Touch target spec: tappable area at least 44×44 CSS px (Material 48dp); 8px or more between neighbours; pad small glyphs up to the minimum with transparent padding or a pseudo-element; the default 24px icon plus 10px padding reaches 44px; list rows no shorter than 44px; no action should be hover-only.

implementation.zh: 用 min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px 给按钮、图标按钮和列表行兜底，容器用 display: flex; gap: 8px 控制间距。图标热区不足时用 padding 或 ::before 的负 inset 扩展，不要放大图标本身。用 :active / :focus-visible 给出命中反馈。检查所有触控目标在 320px 宽屏下不重叠。
implementation.en: Back buttons, icon buttons and list rows with min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px, and space them with display: flex; gap: 8px. When an icon's hit area is short, extend it with padding or a negative-inset ::before rather than enlarging the glyph. Provide :active / :focus-visible feedback. Verify no targets overlap at 320px wide.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中落实触控目标尺寸。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 所有可交互元素热区至少 44×44 CSS 像素，间距不少于 8px
- 小图标用内边距或伪元素扩展热区，不改变视觉尺寸
- 提供可见的按下与聚焦反馈，不依赖 hover
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Enforce touch target sizes in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- Every interactive element has a hit area of at least 44×44 CSS px with 8px spacing
- Small icons extend their hit area via padding or pseudo-elements without changing visual size
- Provide visible press and focus feedback; never rely on hover
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.
